title: HarmLevelBench: Evaluating Harm-Level Compliance and the Impact of Quantization on Model Alignment
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLM safety and alignment by categorizing queries according to levels of harm. Crucially, its 'Harm Level Notation' (Table 7) uses 'Legality/Morality' as a primary metric for classification, distinguishing between responses that are 'Legal & Ethical', 'Potentially Illegal', or 'Illegal & Immoral'.
